title: percent_encode in stoa-ctl is incorrect for non-ASCII chars; should use urlencoding crate
description: ctl/src/main.rs:212 percent_encode uses char as u32 for the code point, which produces single-byte encoding (e.g. U+00E9 → %E9). RFC 3986 requires UTF-8 encoding first (U+00E9 = C3 A9 → %C3%A9). Group names are currently ASCII-only so this never triggers, but the function is wrong and is a maintenance target. Replace with the urlencoding crate (already in the Rust ecosystem, no version risk): urlencoding::encode(s).into_owned(). The hand-rolled function also diverges from what stoa-ctl test vectors verify.
